theorem mvcc.bucketOf_mem_of_BucketHas (log : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf log) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (kv
    : EtcdKv) (h : mvcc.BucketHas log rev kv) (hmod : kv.modRev = rev.main) : (mvcc.revBytes rev
    false, mvcc.kvEncode kv) ∈ mvcc.bucketOf log

theorem mvcc.set_filled {ps : List Loc} {i n : Nat} (hps : ps.length = i) (hin : i < n) (p : Loc) :
    (ps ++ List.replicate (n - i) (zero_val Loc)).set i p = ps ++ [p] ++ List.replicate (n - (i +
    1)) (zero_val Loc)

def mvcc.delKeys (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) : List
    GoString :=
  List.map Prod.fst (mvcc.rangeTaken (ilog ++ [pend]) endNil k e (W64 ↑(mvcc.writeRev ilog pend)) (W64 0))

def mvcc.writeRev (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : Nat :=
  if pend = [] then List.length ilog - 1 else List.length ilog

theorem mvcc.revBytes_inj (a b : mvcc.Rev) (ta tb : Bool) (h : mvcc.revBytes a ta = mvcc.revBytes b
    tb) : ta = tb ∧ a = b

theorem mvcc.changeKv_append_lt (r : w64) (s : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (c :
    mvcc.Change) {i : Nat} (hi : i < cs.length) : mvcc.changeKv r s (cs ++ [c]) i = mvcc.changeKv r
    s cs i

def mvcc.pendPuts (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : List (GoString × GoString) :=
  mvcc.bucketOfRev (List.length ilog) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend

theorem mvcc.capWithLimit_rangeTaken (log : mvcc.Log) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (atRev limit
    : w64) : mvcc.capWithLimit limit (mvcc.rangeTaken log endNil k e atRev limit).length =
    (mvcc.rangeTaken log endNil k e atRev limit).length

theorem mvcc.W64_toNat (x : w64) : W64 ↑(BitVec.toNat x) = x

theorem mvcc.findKey_key {k : GoString} {s : List EtcdKv} {kv : EtcdKv} (h : mvcc.findKey k s = some
    kv) : kv.key = k

theorem mvcc.lookup_foldl_insert (l : List (GoString × GoString)) (m : GMap GoString GoString) (k :
    GoString) : List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m l !! k = match List.find? (fun p =>
    decide (p.fst = k)) l.reverse with | some p => some p.snd | none => m !! k

theorem mvcc.applyChanges_append_singleton (r : w64) (s : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (c :
    mvcc.Change) : mvcc.applyChanges r s (cs ++ [c]) = mvcc.applyChange r (mvcc.applyChanges r s cs)
    c

theorem mvcc.LogWf'.append_change {ilog : mvcc.Log} {pend : List mvcc.Change} (h : mvcc.LogWf' (ilog
    ++ [pend])) (hne : ilog ≠ []) (c : mvcc.Change) (hc : ∀ (k : GoString), c = mvcc.Change.del k →
    (mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog)
    pend)).isSome = true) : mvcc.LogWf' (ilog ++ [pend ++ [c]])

def mvcc.putKvOf (k v : GoString) (l r : w64) : Option (mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64) → EtcdKv :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (fst, c, ver) => { key := k, createRev := c, modRev := r, version := ver + W64 1, value := v, lease := l }
  | none => { key := k, createRev := r, modRev := r, version := W64 1, value := v, lease := l }

def mvcc.capWithLimit (limit : w64) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  if sint.Z limit ≤ 0 ∨ ↑n < sint.Z limit then n else (sint.Z limit).toNat

theorem mvcc.findKey_putKv_self_eq {s : List EtcdKv} (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s) (r : w64) (k
    v : GoString) (l : w64) : mvcc.findKey k (putKv r k v l s) = some (match mvcc.findKey k s with |
    some old => { key := old.key, createRev := old.createRev, modRev := r, version := old.version +
    W64 1, value := v, lease := l } | none => { key := k, createRev := r, modRev := r, version :=
    W64 1, value := v, lease := l })

theorem mvcc.findKey_applyChanges_dels (r : w64) (k : GoString) (ks : List GoString) (s : List
    EtcdKv) : ¬k ∈ ks → mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges r s (List.map mvcc.Change.del ks)) =
    mvcc.findKey k s

theorem mvcc.rangeAt_keys_sublist (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (k e : GoString) (atRev : w64) : (List.map
    Prod.fst (mvcc.rangeAt idx k e atRev)).Sublist (List.map Prod.fst idx)

theorem mvcc.LogWf.of_wf' {log : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.LogWf' log) (hne : log ≠ []) : mvcc.LogWf log

theorem mvcc.changeKv_put (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (k v : GoString) (l : w64)
    (hwf : mvcc.LogWf (ilog ++ [pend])) (hlen : List.length (ilog ++ [pend]) < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs
    : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ilog ++ [pend] → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.changeKv (W64
    ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) (pend ++ [mvcc.Change.put k v l]) pend.length = some
    (mvcc.putKvOf k v l (W64 ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++
    [pend])) k) (W64 ↑(List.length ilog))))

theorem mvcc.rangeAnswers_nil_length_le (log : mvcc.Log) (k e : GoString) (atRev : w64) :
    (mvcc.rangeAnswers log true k e atRev).length ≤ 1

theorem mvcc.pendPuts_append (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (c : mvcc.Change) (kv :
    EtcdKv) (hkv : mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) (pend ++ [c])
    pend.length = some kv) : mvcc.pendPuts ilog (pend ++ [c]) = mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend ++
    [(mvcc.revBytes { main := W64 ↑(List.length ilog), sub := W64 ↑pend.length } c.isDel,
    mvcc.kvEncode kv)]

theorem mvcc.bucketMap_lookup_of_mem (log : mvcc.Log) (key v : GoString) (hmem : (key, v) ∈
    mvcc.bucketOf log) (hfun : ∀ (p : GoString × GoString), p ∈ mvcc.bucketOf log → p.fst = key →
    p.snd = v) : mvcc.bucketMap log !! key = some v

theorem mvcc.delKeys_present (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (endNil : Bool) (k e :
    GoString) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf (ilog ++ [pend])) (hlen : List.length (ilog ++ [pend]) < 2 ^ 63)
    (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ilog ++ [pend] → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hne : ilog ≠ [])
    (kk : GoString) : kk ∈ mvcc.delKeys ilog pend endNil k e → (mvcc.findKey kk (mvcc.applyChanges
    (W64 ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend)).isSome = true

theorem mvcc.mem_rangeAnswers_of_taken (log : mvcc.Log) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (atRev
    limit : w64) (a : GoString × mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64) (h : a ∈ mvcc.rangeTaken log endNil k e atRev
    limit) : a ∈ mvcc.rangeAnswers log endNil k e atRev

theorem mvcc.bucketMap_append (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hne : ilog ≠ []) :
    mvcc.bucketMap (ilog ++ [pend]) = List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) (mvcc.bucketMap
    ilog) (mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend)

theorem mvcc.stateAt_writeRev (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hne : ilog ≠ []) :
    mvcc.stateAt (ilog ++ [pend]) (mvcc.writeRev ilog pend) = mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length
    ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend

theorem mvcc.W64_inj_of_lt {a b : Nat} (ha : a < 2 ^ 64) (hb : b < 2 ^ 64) (h : W64 ↑a = W64 ↑b) : a
    = b

theorem mvcc.stateAt_pend (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.stateAt (ilog ++
    [pend]) (List.length ilog) = mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length ilog)) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog)
    pend

theorem mvcc.delKeys_nodup (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (endNil : Bool) (k e :
    GoString) : (mvcc.delKeys ilog pend endNil k e).Nodup

theorem mvcc.bucketOf_append (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hne : ilog ≠ []) :
    mvcc.bucketOf (ilog ++ [pend]) = mvcc.bucketOf ilog ++ mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend

theorem mvcc.rangeTotal_of_taken_nil (log : mvcc.Log) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (atRev limit
    : w64) (withTotal : Bool) (h : mvcc.rangeTaken log endNil k e atRev limit = []) :
    mvcc.rangeTotal log endNil k e atRev limit withTotal = 0

theorem mvcc.W64_sint_nat (x : w64) (h : 0 ≤ sint.Z x) : W64 ↑(sint.nat x) = x

theorem mvcc.rangeAnswers_kv (log : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^
    63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (endNil : Bool) (k e :
    GoString) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 2 ^ 63) (a : GoString × mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64) : a ∈
    mvcc.rangeAnswers log endNil k e (W64 ↑r) → ∃ kv, mvcc.findKey a.fst (mvcc.stateAt log r) = some
    kv ∧ kv.modRev = a.snd.fst.main ∧ kv.createRev = a.snd.snd.fst ∧ kv.version = a.snd.snd.snd ∧
    mvcc.bucketMap log !! mvcc.revBytes a.snd.fst false = some (mvcc.kvEncode kv)

theorem mvcc.writeRev_lt (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hne : ilog ≠ []) :
    mvcc.writeRev ilog pend < List.length (ilog ++ [pend])

theorem mvcc.bucketMap_lookup_of_BucketHas (log : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf log) (hlen :
    List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (rev
    : mvcc.Rev) (kv : EtcdKv) (h : mvcc.BucketHas log rev kv) (hmod : kv.modRev = rev.main) :
    mvcc.bucketMap log !! mvcc.revBytes rev false = some (mvcc.kvEncode kv)

theorem mvcc.bucketOf_fun (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (p : GoString × GoString) : p ∈ mvcc.bucketOf log →
    ∀ (q : GoString × GoString), q ∈ mvcc.bucketOf log → p.fst = q.fst → p.snd = q.snd

theorem mvcc.pendPuts_nil (ilog : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.pendPuts ilog [] = []
